Maya (PM): Quick sync idea: define a 'soft-pin window' + emergency escape for tenant migrations. Want to balance customer control (longer pins) vs platform safety. Looking for concrete gates and required telemetry.

Jonah (Eng-ML): Agree. Proposal: two-phase bench: (1) micro-smoke (10 prompts, 20 runs) for perf regressions, (2) fidelity validation (held-out eval set) for quality. Both produce a pass/fail.

Priya (Eng Platform): Platform constraints: routing priority must be deterministic: explicit soft-pin > tenant override > global default. We'll add a 'pin-window-id' header to trace routing. Also need a TTL enforcement job to expire pins and emit an audit event.

Ava (SRE): Safety net: add a circuit breaker per-tenant that trips on combined signals: error rate > 1.5% OR P95 latency increase > 1.8x OR cost-per-token spike > 2x within 10m. When tripped, traffic falls back to previous pinned model with <5s failover. Ops owns manual release.

Carlos (Customer Success): Field asks: customers want a preview mode where they can route 1% of traffic to the candidate and get a downloadable migration report. Include an "approve" button we can click to extend TTL.

Liam (Sales): Also hearing requests for contractual extended-window (90/180 days). Need to flag billing implications. Can we make extended TTL a billable feature toggle?

Maya (PM): Draft launch criteria idea:
- Micro-smoke: P50 delta <= 10ms, P95 delta <= 30%
- Fidelity: top-level eval score drop <= 0.8% absolute
- Canary: min 24h at 1% traffic or 72h at 0.2% with no safety-trips
- TTL default: 14d, tenant-configurable up to 60d for self-serve, >60d via contract
- Audit & report: automated PDF with pre/post metrics + sample traces

Jonah (Eng-ML): For the fidelity check we should surface the failure cases (diffs) so CS can triage. Also propose a tiny SDK to let customers run the smoke bench against their prompt set before opting in.

Priya (Eng Platform): Implementation notes: DB schema additions: catalog_pins table with fields as strings: tenant_id, model_id, pin_kind, expires_at, created_by, reason, legacy_mapped (y/n). We'll emit an event on create/expire/force-unpin. Also need migration for tenants with hard-pins to map to soft-pin with infinite TTL until reviewed.

Ava (SRE): Monitoring checklist: per-tenant p50/p95, error-rate, cost-per-token, rolling retries, spike detector on anomalous latencies. Pager thresholds: hit on safety-trip. Add a 'panic' endpoint for ops: POST /panic/{tenant_id}?target_model={model_id}.

Carlos (Customer Success): I'll draft the preview report template: delta charts, example prompts that regressed, recommendation (tune temperature, batch size) and comms copy. Also propose a checkbox in the report: "Schedule assisted cutover".

Maya (PM): Owners/ETAs: Jonah -> bench SDK + diffs output (10 days); Priya -> pin schema + TTL job + header (2w); Ava -> circuit-breaker + panic endpoint (2w); Carlos -> preview report + comms (4d); Liam -> pricing note for extended TTL (4d). I'll put together a short PRD with the gates above.

comm-bot: Created preview-job: preview/softpin-tenant-sample-001 (runs hourly).

Jonah (Eng-ML): Cool. I'll add a simple curl example for the SDK docs and drop into the PRD.

Priya (Eng Platform): Noted. If anyone needs a migration table sample, ping me and I'll export the legacy pins.

Maya (PM): Thanks all. If you spot blockers to these timelines, flag in-thread by EOD.
